traits.definition: Median of empirical field-study mean flying travel speeds in Dyer et al. 2023. Direct observation or telemetry only; laboratory trials, reported medians and fitted predictions are excluded. Flight can include gliding and is not a maximum dive or sprint. Study sex and life stage are not standardized; the full included study-mean envelope is checked.
